description: This file defines the GatewayDuplicateHeaderException class, a custom exception used within the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate that a request contained duplicate header fields. It includes builder patterns, static factory methods, and metadata annotations relevant to this specific exception type.

classes.name: GatewayDuplicateHeaderException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a request included duplicate header fields. It extends DittoRuntimeException and implements GatewayException, providing static factory methods and a builder for creating instances with detailed context.

classes.name: GatewayDuplicateHeaderException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class providing a fluent API to construct instances of GatewayDuplicateHeaderException with customizable message, description, cause, and href.

methods.name: GatewayDuplicateHeaderException.newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for constructing GatewayDuplicateHeaderException objects.

methods.name: GatewayDuplicateHeaderException.fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an exception instance with a custom message and headers.

methods.name: GatewayDuplicateHeaderException.fromJson
methods.description: Creates an exception instance based on a JSON object representing the error.

methods.name: GatewayDuplicateHeaderException.setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new exception instance with the provided headers, copying existing message, description, cause, and href.
